label: Ballwin area (west St. Louis County, not the City of St. Louis)

county_election_office.name: St. Louis County Board of Elections, 725 Northwest Plaza Dr., St. Ann, MO 63074 (the county board, not the City of St. Louis board downtown). Mon to Fri 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

zip_caveats: Ballwin is in west St. Louis County. ZIP 63011 also reaches nearby cities and unincorporated areas. The county’s official election and ZIP maps confirm County Council Districts 3 and 7 and the Parkway and Rockwood school districts. State House districts 88, 89, 98, 100, 101 and 110 overlap the ZIP. The ZIP is in Senate District 15, which has no race this year, and Congressional District 2. Parkway Prop P applies only in the Parkway School District. A Ballwin mailing address alone does not tell you your school district, council district or city. Use the county’s current Sample Ballot Lookup to confirm each item.
